keySentence: Pollyanna always played the glad game.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Aunt gave her a hot attic room. Pollyanna did not cry. She found something good about it. Pollyanna always played the glad game.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Aunt Polly gave Pollyanna a small, hot room in the attic. There was no mirror, no pictures, and very little furniture. But Pollyanna smiled and found something to be happy about. Pollyanna always played the glad game in every situation. She said she was glad there was no mirror to see her freckles. Her positive attitude amazed everyone who met her.
